name: risk
description: Risk Digital Board Game - multi-screen strategy game with .NET server, React handset, and Unity TV app
prompt: You are helping build Risk Digital, a digital adaptation of the classic Risk board game. Architecture: .NET 8 SignalR server (server/), React/Vite/Tailwind handset app (handset/), Unity 2D for TV display (tv/). All communicate via SignalR. The developer is experienced with C#/.NET and React but learning Unity. Keep code minimal and clean. Match existing patterns in each sub-project.
